Overview

Busan is a city in BUS with a population of 3,453,000. Korea’s second-largest city and premier port, known for its stunning beaches, seafood markets, and the Busan International Film Festival. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
